# signoz_downtime_schedule (Resource)

Creates and manages downtime schedule resources in SigNoz. Downtime schedules allow you to suppress alert notifications during planned maintenance windows.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    signoz = {
      source = "registry.terraform.io/signoz/signoz"
    }
  }
}

provider "signoz" {
  endpoint     = "http://localhost:3301"
  access_token = "<SIGNOZ-API-KEY>"
}

resource "signoz_downtime_schedule" "weekly_maintenance" {
  name        = "Weekly maintenance"
  description = "Suppress alerts during weekly maintenance window"
  alert_ids   = ["5", "10"]
  all_alerts  = false

  schedule {
    start_time = "2024-01-15T02:00:00Z"
    end_time   = "2024-01-15T04:00:00Z"
    timezone   = "UTC"

    recurrence {
      type         = "weekly"
      days_of_week = [0, 6]
      duration     = "2h"
    }
  }
}

resource "signoz_downtime_schedule" "one_time" {
  name        = "One-time deployment window"
  description = "Suppress all alerts during deployment"
  all_alerts  = true

  schedule {
    start_time = "2024-02-01T00:00:00Z"
    end_time   = "2024-02-01T06:00:00Z"
    timezone   = "America/New_York"

    recurrence {
      type = "once"
    }
  }
}

output "downtime_schedule" {
  value = signoz_downtime_schedule.weekly_maintenance
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the downtime schedule.
- `schedule` (Attributes) Schedule configuration for the downtime window. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedule))

### Optional

- `alert_ids` (List of String) List of alert IDs to suppress during the downtime window.
- `all_alerts` (Boolean) Whether to suppress all alerts during the downtime window. By default, it is false.
- `description` (String) Description of the downtime schedule.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time of the downtime schedule.
- `created_by` (String) Creator of the downtime schedule.
- `id` (String) Autogenerated unique ID for the downtime schedule.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time of the downtime schedule.
- `updated_by` (String) Last updater of the downtime schedule.

<a id="nestedatt--schedule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedule`

Required:

- `end_time` (String) End time of the downtime window in RFC3339 format.
- `start_time` (String) Start time of the downtime window in RFC3339 format.
- `timezone` (String) Timezone of the downtime schedule (e.g., UTC, America/New_York).

Optional:

- `recurrence` (Attributes) Recurrence configuration for the downtime schedule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedule--recurrence))

<a id="nestedatt--schedule--recurrence"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedule.recurrence`

Required:

- `type` (String) Type of recurrence. Possible values are: once, daily, weekly.

Optional:

- `days_of_week` (List of Number) Days of the week for weekly recurrence (0=Sunday, 6=Saturday).
- `duration` (String) Duration of the downtime window for recurring schedules (e.g., 2h, 30m).
